rationale: Standard oral-to-LAI initiation: confirm tolerability of oral risperidone first, then start Risperdal Consta with mandatory 21-day oral overlap because the microsphere depot does not reach therapeutic levels until ~3 weeks after the first injection. Stopping oral too early risks relapse during the gap. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

schedule.notes: Continue oral risperidone 4 mg. Inject Risperdal Consta 25 mg deltoid (first injection). Counsel patient that depot takes 3 weeks to start working.
Continue oral risperidone 4 mg. Second Consta 25 mg injection (every 2 weeks).
Reduce oral to 2 mg as depot begins to release. Clinical effect of Consta now emerging.
Stop oral risperidone. Third Consta 25 mg injection. Maintenance every 2 weeks ongoing.

doseRatios.equivalencyNote: Approximate clinical equivalency: oral risperidone 4 mg/day ≈ Consta 25 mg every 2 weeks (Maudsley 14th). For higher oral doses (>4 mg), use Consta 37.5 or 50 mg. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
